  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust downward for persistent positive sentiment (sentiment > 0.2) when model shows upward bias.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast deviates > ±10% from 5-day moving average of true prices.",
    "Lower forecast if sentiment history shows consecutive negative sentiment (e.g., >3 days with sentiment < 0.0).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true price drops when sentiment is negative (e.g., sentiment < 0.0).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility; use 15-day history as anchor for correction.",
    "If true price falls below 65.00 after 3 consecutive days above 70.00, reduce forecast by 5–10%.",
    "When sentiment is positive but price is trending down, reduce forecast slope to avoid overcorrection."
  ]
}
